components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;margin-top:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;background:#F4F4F4;border-radius:22px;padding:48px 20px 20px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,.04),0 8px 24px -8px rgba(10,10,10,.10);font-family:'Urbanist Variable',sans-serif;color:#0A0A0A;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(10,10,10,.05),0 18px 36px -12px rgba(10,10,10,.18)}.ds-med{position:absolute;top:-28px;left:20px;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,10,.04),0 6px 18px -8px rgba(10,10,10,.12)}.ds-card b{font-size:18px}.ds-card small{color:#6B6B6B;font-size:14px}.ds-card strong{font-size:30px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-top:12px}.ds-bar{height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.1);margin-top:16px;overflow:hidden}.ds-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:9px}

narrative.overview:
A white app frame on a pale gray canvas. The sidebar is pure black, content sits on soft gray tiles, and every action is a black pill. Black, white and gray carry the whole identity, so the only colour on screen is data: green, amber and red outcomes, and the red overdue zone. Colour therefore always means something happened.

The mood is calm, editorial and confident: big black numerals, bold titles, generous tiles. Depth is almost flat. Tiles are distinguished by tone, not shadow, and only white medallions and lifted cards cast a soft shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Black, white and grays only; colour is reserved for status.
Black sidebar, black primary buttons, one black accent block per cluster.
Gray tiles on a white frame, with white medallions and chips on the tiles.
Big bold figures in Urbanist with tabular numerals.
One authored motion moment on load.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: Only ok, warn and bad (with their washes) may add hue. Never introduce a brand colour.

rules.name: The One Black Block Rule
rules.body: Within a cluster, one black block anchors it (the raised stat cell, the last-run card). Everything else stays gray or white.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every price, count, percentage, and table cell uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Meta lines (brand · category · id) sit below the title, never above it.

dos: Do show failures as failures: gaps plus red dashed markers in charts, and error codes in logs.
Do keep secondary text on black at Soft Ink or white.
Do keep motion to the single load moment plus sheet and scrim entrances.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, or dark mode.
Don't add a brand hue; black, white and gray are the brand.
Don't smooth chart lines (no monotone curves) or carry prices across failures.
Don't fade whole cards to show a state; use a pill.
